conventions.energy: E = 1/(32 sqrt2 pi^2) Int [ d_i phi.d_i phi + 1/2 (d_i phi x d_j phi)^2 ] d^3x (Sutcliffe 2007), Ward bound E >= Q^{3/4}
conventions.lattice: forward-difference links (sigma term) + 4-corner plaquette average (Skyrme term), exact discrete gradient, field fixed to e3 on the boundary of [-L,L]^3, L = 7.5
conventions.hopf: Q_W = (1/16 pi^2) Int A.B, B_i = 1/2 eps_ijk phi.(d_j phi x d_k phi), curl A = B (Coulomb gauge, FFT); with W=(phi1+i phi2)/(1+phi3) and Sutcliffe's (Z1,Z0) the rational map W=Z1^n/Z0^m gives Q_W = -nm in the standard orientation of R^3 (the map R^3 -> S^3 of Sutcliffe eq. 3.1 reverses orientation). Q is reported with Sutcliffe's sign, Q = -Q_W.
conventions.position_curve: preimage of -e3; linking curve: preimage of (sqrt(2mu-mu^2),0,-1+mu), mu=0.1; tube phi3 < -0.8
